user.title: Choose the RBgrid hub
user.description: Hubs are ESPHome devices with the rbgrid component that Home Assistant has already adopted. Add the hub through the ESPHome integration first if it is not listed.

esphome_missing.title: Waiting for the ESPHome integration
esphome_missing.description: {name} is an ESPHome device. Home Assistant must adopt it through the ESPHome integration first (it shows up as “Discovered” on this page too). Add it there, then press Submit here.

options.title: Set up {name}
options.description: {model} · {sw}. The RBgrid panel appears in the sidebar and the hub's hourly history is imported into long-term statistics automatically.

data.setup_energy: Configure the Energy dashboard with this hub (grid import/export, cost and export value from the hub, every point as an individual device)
data.sync_currency: Set the hub's tariff plan to Home Assistant's currency ({currency}) — the hub and Home Assistant must use one currency, there is no conversion

abort.no_hubs: No RBgrid hub found among the ESPHome devices. Add the hub through the ESPHome integration first.
abort.all_configured: Every RBgrid hub in Home Assistant is already configured.
abort.no_mac: The discovered device did not report a MAC address.

create_entry.default: {name} is set up. The **RBgrid Hub** panel is in the sidebar (also at /rbgrid); the hub's own device page offers *Visit* to open it. Statistics import starts within a minute; the Energy dashboard shows the hub after the next full hour.

data.price_entity: Price sensor pushed to the hub as external price (Nord Pool, ENTSO-e, Tibber… — leave empty to use the hub's tariff plan only)
data.setup_energy: Configure the Energy dashboard with this hub again
data.sync_currency: Write Home Assistant's currency ({currency}) into the hub's tariff plan now

options.mwh: Currency per MWh (e.g. EUR/MWh, core Nord Pool action results)

set_prices.name: Set external prices
set_prices.description: Send energy prices to the hub; each entry replaces the tariff zone's energy rate for its time range (fees and VAT of the plan still apply).

prices.name: Prices
prices.description: List of entries with buy, sell (optional), from and until (unix seconds); up to 192 entries.

buy.name: Buy price
buy.description: One price per kWh (alternative to the list).

clear_prices.name: Clear external prices
clear_prices.description: Drop every external price; the tariff plan applies again.

command.name: Send a command
command.description: Run one rbgrid_cmd command (JSON object) and return the device reply with parts reassembled.

command.name: Command
command.description: The command object, for example cmd: get, section: sensors.

import_statistics.name: Import history into statistics
import_statistics.description: Import the hub's stored hourly history into long-term statistics now.
